title: THETA: Heat Diffusion as a Structural Prior for Cross-Domain Transfer in Graph Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. translated_title: THETA：将热扩散作为图基础模型跨域迁移的结构先验
translated_abstract: 图基础模型（GFMs）旨在跨具有异构节点属性和图结构的不同领域学习可迁移的表示。然而，从节点属性推断的关系可能依赖于特定领域的特征语义，这限制了它们向未见图的迁移能力，尤其是在低标签场景下。我们提出了THETA（Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer，拓扑感知热迁移），这是一种图基础模型，它利用热核签名（HKS）作为基于拓扑的结构先验来实现跨域迁移。通过刻画节点在不同扩散尺度上的热回流行为，HKS提供了一种跨图的通用结构描述符，无需对齐属性语义，并用局部和多尺度连接性信息来补充基于特征的关系。THETA将这一先验融入预训练和少样本适配中。在预训练阶段，它将HKS与节点属性相结合以构建精细化的图视图（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出THETA图基础模型，创新性地将热核签名（HKS）作为拓扑结构先验融入预训练与少样本适配，无需对齐属性语义即可实现跨异构领域的高效迁移，尤其适用于低标签场景。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes THETA, a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior in both pre-training and few-shot adaptation, enabling cross-domain transfer over heterogeneous graphs without aligned attribute semantics, especially in low-label regimes.
